page.title: Shot builder
page.purpose: Compose a readable device presentation with guided defaults and full calibration, lighting, camera and timeline control over the same saved shot.

priorities.statement: See a trustworthy preview of the shot and its current route.
Change the next useful property without losing source fidelity.
Reach advanced precision without changing the underlying shot model.

states.description: No operation is pending; identify the current task and available next action.
Work is acknowledged and queued or in flight with observed progress or an honest indeterminate state.
A safe retry is actively reconciling or executing without blind duplicate side effects.
Explain the current task, saved revision and next meaningful action.
Name what is loading; retain stable layout and existing local content.
Acknowledge the requested operation once and prevent duplicate costly submissions.
Distinguish local draft changes from durably saved revision; never claim saved early.
Explain local versus remote state and conflict resolution without silently overwriting edits.
Retain usable content and identify the specific information being refreshed.
Explain why there is no content and offer a relevant low-risk first action.
Show which inputs, output or services are available and which remain incomplete.
Show age, affected decisions and explicit refresh; never silently spend on refresh.
Confirm the concrete durable result and offer inspection or the next task.
Associate actionable correction with each invalid field while preserving input.
Explain the failed operation, preserved work and safe next action with diagnostic reference.
Identify the unavailable operation and authority boundary without requesting unrelated access.
Keep supported local work usable; mark online operations unavailable and never auto-submit paid work on reconnect.
Explain whether retry reuses an operation identity, reconciles prior work or starts a newly authorized operation.
Show active mask/corner handles, cutout exclusion, source grid and numeric alternatives without making an unearned calibrated-fit claim.
Name missing physical parts/joints or route capability; preserve requested motion until user deliberately chooses a valid alternative.
Label preview revision and exactly what changed since render.
Retain local draft and distinguish it from durable and submitted revisions.
Expose hold/loop/trim policy rather than silently resetting playback.
Show exact snapshot, worker/profile, output duration/resolution/color/audio, estimated latency/cost and privacy/authority/budget checks.

x-design.layout: Desktop: source/asset bin, dominant stage, properties inspector, timeline below. Guided steps Setup, Content, Motion, Look, Output; Advanced reveals precise controls over identical state. Mobile: stage plus one inspector/timeline panel at a time, with all controls reachable.
controls: Select device, scene, presentation route and qualified motion; show compatible alternatives
Import/select real recording; inspect source aspect, duration, timestamp/frame-rate behavior, audio and provenance; declare app-only versus already-complete system capture
Contain whole capture by default; explicit crop with visible lost-content guides; manage orientation and multi-display allocation
Calibrate plate corners, active mask, round corners and cutout exclusion; compare raw source and composite
Configure simulated status and home regions outside capture: clock, signal, wifi, battery, theme, sampled/override colors; label simulated chrome
For desktop profiles configure wallpaper, menu/status bar, dock and browser bounds/title/URL/tabs/theme around the named app viewport; label these as simulations
Set physical dimensions/axes, support contact, joint pivot/limits, camera lens/pose and non-clipping margins
Control environment/HDRI, softboxes, reflection cards, exposure, material response and route-specific capabilities
Choose scene placement slots and attachments; inspect support/contact, mounting, occlusion, scale and compatible camera envelope before moving devices
Edit camera/device/joint/source tracks with numeric keyframes, easing, tangents, range and last readable fixed hold
Trim/offset/hold/loop source independent of reveal motion; explicit audio include/mute/trim and clip-level policy
A/B draft preview versus final-render representative, request costed preview, select final output profile and submit render
details: Photographic mode warps screen into a static plate and can move crop/camera only within supported semantics; a physical spin/lid closure requires true articulated 3D.
Only the pill is black hardware; colored active pixels continue above/beside/below it. Full capture remains contained below deliberately simulated OS chrome.
Masks are distinct: active display, cutouts, occluders/reflections and optional overlay; curved/multiple/folding displays require explicit mappings.
A full-screen capture that already includes system chrome does not receive a second status and home bar by default; show the chosen profile and original bounds before saving.

Preview labels static representative versus moving texture, raster versus portable/native, color transform and approximation limitations. Any AI denoiser/upscaler is labeled as AI processing before its explicit initiation, including local inference.
Motion and source playback have separate clocks; decisive source content appears after reveal rather than disappearing during rotation.

Simulated padding sampling policy is fixed, per-frame, temporally filtered or keyed; only padding changes, never invented app pixels. Multi-display source transitions preserve exact captured layout and physical hinge gaps.
Unsaved changes, inherited asset version and render snapshot revision remain visible. Destructive route changes show retained/lost settings before confirmation.
Calibration has zoom/magnifier, corner snapping only when explicit, undo/redo, numeric entry, reset and keyboard movement; no drag-only control.

x-evidence-policy: No fake selectors, region bindings, setup hooks, captures or attestations. Planned controls are metadata until implemented and grounded.
